general_background.title: Contact and transport in solids
general_background.summary: Solid-state conversion depends on contact between reactants and transport across their interfaces. Mechanical activation can create fresh interfaces and defects, which can help subsequent chemical conversion.

general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available.
